# Instructions

This scaffold is a report template for Practical 1 and Practical 2. Replace
each placeholder with your own results and interpretation.

```{r setup}
find_repo_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  current <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  while (TRUE) {
    candidate_bootstrap <- file.path(current, "bootstrap.R")
    candidate_desc <- file.path(current, "DESCRIPTION")
    if (file.exists(candidate_bootstrap) && file.exists(candidate_desc)) {
      return(current)
    }

    parent <- dirname(current)
    if (identical(parent, current)) {
      stop(
        "Could not find rPVA repo root from this working directory. ",
        "Run Quarto from a directory that includes DESCRIPTION and bootstrap.R (for example the repo root), ",
        "or use `setwd()` to switch to the repo root before rendering."
      )
    }
    current <- parent
  }
}
repo_root <- find_repo_root()

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = repo_root)
bootstrap_path <- file.path(repo_root, "bootstrap.R")
source(bootstrap_path, chdir = TRUE)
```

## Model steps

```{r methods-code}
# Example: run_scenarios and one scenario visualisation
# Replace scenario_id as needed
woodhen_tbl <- run_scenarios("woodhen", csv_out = NULL, rds_out = NULL, keep_traj = FALSE, parallel = FALSE)
print(woodhen_tbl)

spec <- set_scenario("02_pig_control", "woodhen")
sim <- run_pva_core(spec, keep_traj = TRUE, seed = 123, verbose = FALSE)
sim_summary <- summarize_pva_result(sim)
sim_diagnostics <- diagnose_pva_result(sim)
```

## Sensitivity check (bounded)

```{r sensitivity}
base <- set_scenario("sensitivity_analysis", "woodhen")
s1 <- run_pva_core(base, keep_traj = FALSE, seed = 123)
s2 <- run_pva_core(modifyList(base, list(surv = base$surv * 0.90)),
                  keep_traj = FALSE, seed = 123)
s3 <- run_pva_core(modifyList(base, list(K = 250)),
                  keep_traj = FALSE, seed = 123)

compare_pva_results(
  list(s1, s2, s3),
  scenarios = c("baseline", "survival_minus_10pct", "K_250")
)
```
